name: cTSEffectsResource::cTSEffectsResource
notes: Lane IT. Standalone shape (src/ts/cTSEffectsResource.h: our class derives from cITSEffectsResource +0, cTSEffectsCollection +4 (ours, lane IT) and cGZPersistResource +0x78; 0xb8 bytes, member offsets static_asserted). Hooked through the Construct adapter; Create 0xbd2f90 is hooked too, and the factory's slot 9 (0xbd2ed0, inline new plus this constructor) reaches the constructor hook, so every resource carries our vtables. EffectsResource_Operations builds each side from the same garbage-filled block (mode 0 the original constructor and the RVAs, 1 ours through our vtables, 2 the original constructor and the adapters) and compares after every random operation the result, the call log of every fake (streams, descriptions, stand-ins) and the whole resource (the collection with buckets and capacities, the persist resource's count and key, the name, the string list). Not ours yet, stood in by the test and listed here: 6 of the 13 description factories (0xbe7ba0 ... 0xbf9370, one per component type; brush, scrubber, sequence, sound, game, model and water are ours, lane IT's cTSCompDescription, and stood in by the test through our Create), the effect serializers 0xbf9ee0 (write) / 0xbf9da0 (read); Read's stream metadata is our cRZVariant (uint16) since lane LQ, its vtable word checked as a cRZVariant's. Mutants build/it_mut_res.log (33 over the class, all killed).

name: cTSEffectsResource::~cTSEffectsResource
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the Destruct adapter. EffectsResource_Operations ends every seed with the destructor: the releases logged in order, the frees counted by size.

name: cTSEffectsResource scalar deleting destructor (ecx = +0)
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the DeletingDestructor adapter. EffectsResource_CreateDelete calls it with flags 1 and 0 (mode 1 through slot 12 of the collection and persist faces of our vtables, which also covers the compiler's thunks for 0xbd2e3b / 0xbd2e43), and through the last Release.

name: cTSEffectsResource::Create (cdecl, registered by the COM director)
notes: Lane IT. Hooked to cTSEffectsResource::Create (new 0xb8, null on failure). EffectsResource_CreateDelete: the original's Create against ours, then the same operations and deletion paths; the frees compared.

name: cTSEffectsResource::QueryInterface
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the QueryInterface adapter: the collection's id gives the +4 face, the resource's (0xca51189b) +0, anything else the persist resource's QueryInterface (+0x78 for 1 and 0x456b8f1d). EffectsResource_Operations op 11: six ids on each of the three faces; result and out face offset compared.

name: cTSEffectsResource::AddRef
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the AddRef adapter (8 bytes): the persist resource's count. Operations op 12 and CreateDelete.

name: cTSEffectsResource::Release
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the Release adapter (8 bytes): the persist resource's Release (deletes through slot 12 of the persist face at the last). Operations op 12 and CreateDelete (the last Release on each face).

name: cTSEffectsResource::SetName
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the SetName adapter. Operations op 5.

name: cTSEffectsResource::GetName
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the GetName adapter (18 bytes). Operations op 6: the returned pointer's offset in the resource and the text.

name: cTSEffectsResource::MergeInto
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the MergeInto adapter (8 bytes): the collection's merge (0xbd7f30, ours). Operations op 10: into a new collection filled at random, the source's flag at random; the target compared whole.

name: cTSEffectsResource::Write
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the Write adapter. Operations ops 7 and 9: every call into the fake output stream recorded (kind, value, text) and compared; the descriptions' slot 5 and the effect writer stand-in logged.

name: cTSEffectsResource::Read
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the Read adapter. Operations op 8 (random tapes: wrong first version, random counts, odd name entries such as "end" with another index and "END", tapes cut short, after which the fake stream answers "end" and -1) and op 9 (what a Write produced, read back onto the same resource); result, read position and the whole resource compared. Deviation: the text buffer the reads go through is a function-local static of ours (ReadBuffer), where the original's is its own static at 0x10fc89c shared with 0xbd8a70; both are only scratch for one read (the text is copied out at once), so nothing observes which buffer is used. A random tape can leave name indices past the end of the effects (the original does not check); the test then records the state and clears it before going on, since later collection operations index them unchecked on both sides.

name: cTSEffectsResource::GetClassId
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the GetClassId adapter (6 bytes): 0x2a5118ad. Operations op 13.

name: WriteEffectTrigger (cdecl: stream, trigger)
notes: Lane IT. Hooked to WriteEffectTrigger; only Write calls it. Covered by Operations ops 7 and 9 (the original's Write calls the original, ours ours; the stream records compared).

name: ReadEffectTrigger (cdecl: stream, version, trigger)
notes: Lane IT. Hooked to ReadEffectTrigger; only Read calls it. Covered by Operations ops 8 and 9. Shares the original's text buffer static with Read (see 0xbd30f0).

name: cTSEffectsResource::QueryInterface (collection face adjustor thunk, this - 4)
notes: Lane IT. Compiler-made adjustor thunk that exists only in our vtables (no hook: every resource carries ours since the constructor and Create hooks). Operations op 11 calls slot 0 of the +4 face through each side's own vtable.

notes: Lane IT. Compiler-made adjustor thunk that exists only in our vtables (no hook). Operations op 12 and CreateDelete (the last Release) call slot 2 of the +4 face through each side's own vtable.

notes: Lane IT. Compiler-made adjustor thunk that exists only in our vtables (no hook). Operations op 12 and CreateDelete (the last Release) call slot 2 of the +0x78 face through each side's own vtable.
